datasets.scope: All modeled Meta Ads campaigns combined
All modeled Shopify store orders combined

definition_sources.title: Shopify sales reports: sales, discounts, orders and average order value
Shopify return on ad spend: attributed revenue divided by advertising cost

definitions.attributed_orders: Synthetic daily purchase-attribution count; a demo aggregate name, not a native API field claim.
definitions.attributed_revenue: After-discount purchase value of the attributed orders on their purchase date, before later refunds; a synthetic demo aggregate, not a native Meta API field claim.
definitions.clicks: Modeled daily ad clicks, not store orders or unique customers.
definitions.discounts: Supporting daily monetary total, not a discount percentage.
definitions.gross_sales: Modeled item value before discounts and refunds; excludes tax and shipping.
definitions.impressions: Modeled daily ad displays, not unique people.
definitions.leads: Modeled marketing signups, separate from the purchase-count metric; a buyer need not first be counted as a lead.
definitions.net_sales: gross_sales minus discounts minus refund_amount; excludes tax and shipping.
definitions.non_ad_orders: Synthetic organic/repeat-customer orders, generated independently of paid clicks; orders = non_ad_orders + Meta attributed_orders for the same date.
definitions.orders: Synthetic total store order count, including modeled advertising-attributed and other orders.
definitions.quantity: Synthetic gross item units ordered for the day; not order count or units net of later returns.
definitions.refund_amount: Positive merchandise refund amount processed today for modeled orders from 7-21 days earlier; not returned-item count. No other sales reversal types are modeled.
definitions.spend: Media advertising cost in CAD, not a count of orders.

formulas.average_order_value_cad: SUM(gross_sales - discounts) / SUM(orders); before later refunds.
formulas.blended_net_sales_to_ad_spend_ratio: SUM(net_sales) / SUM(spend); includes non-ad orders, so this is not attributed ROAS.
formulas.media_cost_per_attributed_order_cad: SUM(spend) / SUM(attributed_orders); not new-customer acquisition cost.
formulas.media_only_attributed_roas: SUM(attributed_revenue) / SUM(spend); excludes agency fees and creative costs.

limitations: Daily aggregate CSVs for demonstration, not raw connector responses or real customer data.
Model parameters and attribution are invented for this demo, not provider benchmarks.
Correlations are intentionally generated and do not establish real-world causation or attribution.
Most orders are organic/repeat-customer purchases. The small paid-order response can be masked by other demand; the strongest total-sales correlation need not occur at the modeled paid-response lag.
Shared seasonality affects both spending and organic orders; any correlation in store totals must not be attributed entirely to advertising.
Gross and net sales are mathematically related; use cross-dataset pairs for the main demonstration.
Spend is currency and orders are counts; compare spend to sales for a same-unit monetary view, not to the raw height of an order-count line.
Attribution uses purchase dates in this fictional model, not provider attribution windows or native advertising-report time settings.
Attributed purchase revenue excludes later refunds and may exceed net store sales on refund-heavy days.
Revenue and ROAS are not profit; product costs, shipping, tax, fees, agency costs and creative costs are not modeled.

scenario: Low-budget advertising for an established store driven mainly by organic and repeat-customer orders.
